features.behavior: CSS.supports(property, value) and CSS.supports('(prop: value)') parse through ve-style. Compound not/and/or queries are evaluated. Unknown, invalid, and deferred properties return false.
features.diagnostic: capability_unsupported is not used; feature detection is false.

features.gaps: orientation, prefers-*, resolution; change events are dispatched only when listeners are invoked.

features.behavior: Async fetchStart/fetchPoll completed during settle. text/json/arrayBuffer/blob, bodyUsed, clone of unused body, AbortController, ReadableStream body view, bytes via bodyB64.
features.gaps: CORS modes, streaming backpressure against a slow consumer, HTTP/2 push.

features.behavior: Resolves when define() runs; does not resolve early for missing names.

features.gaps: attributeFilter, subtree edge cases, characterData oldValue.

features.behavior: RFC 6455 handshake, masked send, close, open/message/error/close listeners. readyState 0/1/3.
features.gaps: extensions, ping/pong, fragmented frames, TLS frame poll.

features.behavior: open/put/get/delete origin-partitioned stores, createIndex (unique + compound key paths), index.get, IDBCursor, versionchange only when the version increases. Dedicated Worker postMessage evaluates in an isolated ve-vm realm (`typeof document` is undefined).
features.gaps: full worker JS evaluation in a second V8 isolate, Worker importScripts/fetch, quota, IDB transactions abort semantics.

features.behavior: register() records a registration with active=null. describe() reports serviceWorkers:false.
Alt-Svc parser only. describe() reports http3:false.
